claims: The Sundance Institute is a Utah-based nonprofit organization.
The Sundance Institute was founded by Robert Redford in 1981.
The Sundance Institute hosts the annual Sundance Film Festival.
The Sundance Institute offers year-round labs, grants, and mentorship programs for filmmakers, documentalists, and episodic creators.
The Sundance Institute operates labs and grants to support independent artists.
The Sundance Institute operates the Feature Film Program.
The Sundance Institute operates the Documentary Film Program.
The Sundance Institute operates the Composer Lab.
The Sundance Film Festival is a showcase for new American and international independent films.
The Sundance Institute's Ignite Program supports creators aged 18–25.
The Sundance Institute's Indigenous Program supports Native American filmmakers.
Sundance Collab is a digital space offering online workshops, classes, and community networking for storytellers.
The Sundance Institute provides grants for development, production, and editing.
The Sundance Documentary Fund is a grant provided by the Sundance Institute.
